The template library reduces blank-page friction without forcing every project into one shape.

- [Guidance page authoring template](authoring-template.qmd)
- Future additions may include project briefs, data inventories, decision logs, validation plans, and handoff notes.

Templates are examples until explicitly adopted; adapt them to the project and document meaningful deviations.
